title: this parameter types and bind typing
hook: The first parameter named this in a function type is not a real argument — it tells TypeScript what this will be when the function is called. Critical for callbacks, event handlers, and methods passed to map or addEventListener.

blocks.text: A **this parameter** appears as the first parameter: `function click(this: HTMLElement, e: Event)`. It is **not** a runtime argument — it types the **dynamic this** binding. Arrow functions **lexically bind this** and cannot declare a this parameter. `Function.prototype.call`, `apply`, and `bind` change this at runtime; TypeScript's this types document expected binding. Class methods infer this as the class instance.

entries.plainDefinition: Compile-time annotation for dynamic this — erased in emit.
Arrow functions capture enclosing this — no own binding.
Error when this is implicitly any in functions.
Creates bound function with fixed this — changes runtime behavior.

blocks.text: Passing class methods as callbacks loses this without bind or arrow wrappers — classic JavaScript bug. TypeScript `noImplicitThis` catches untyped this. React class components, DOM APIs, and jQuery-style plugins rely on correct this binding. C# extension methods and instance methods have static this — different model entirely.

blocks.text: this-type in interfaces: interface Box { content: string; clone(): this; }. Polymorphic this types for fluent APIs. Callback vs method in strictFunctionTypes — methods bivariant on this. lib.dom.d.ts uses this: void extensively. React 19+ function components avoid class this issues entirely.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected
blocks.body: Thinking this param is a real argument. Not knowing arrow lexical this. Cannot explain detached method bug.

interviewTakeaways: this as first param types dynamic this — not a runtime argument.
Arrow functions: lexical this, no this parameter allowed.
Detached methods lose this — bind, arrow, or wrapper.
60s: this param is compile-time. Arrows capture enclosing this. bind fixes runtime. C# this is static. noImplicitThis catches unsafe this.
commonPitfalls: Weak: this param appears in emitted JS — it does not.
Weak: passing class method as callback without bind/arrow.
Strong: Arrow fields or bind. this: void on DOM callbacks. noImplicitThis in strict.

jsTsCorrelations.note: JS this depends on call site — TypeScript this parameters document expected binding.
